title: The Moth That Led Mira Home (Dry Run)
alternative_titles: The Little Light on the Hill
description: A tiny silver-winged moth leads Mira through a storm to someone who needs a friend. This is an original fictional story sample.
main_character: Mira, a young traveler with short dark hair, a mustard raincoat, and a red scarf

scenes.narration: At midnight, Mira spotted a little brass lantern beneath the bridge. A silver-winged moth fluttered inside it, tapping the glass like it was trying to ask for help.
scenes.visual_description: Mira in a mustard raincoat discovers a glowing brass lantern beneath a stone bridge in the rain. A silver-winged moth taps at the glass.

scenes.narration: Mira opened the lantern. The moth circled her once, then flew toward one dark window on the hill. She followed its tiny light through the rain.
scenes.visual_description: Mira follows the glowing moth along a winding hill path in the rain, toward a small house with one lit window.
scenes.setting: rainy path climbing a hill at night

scenes.narration: An old woman opened the door, smiling. The moth had escaped from her late husband's workshop. He built it to guide lost travelers home. Mira left the lantern by the door. One small light had brought two lonely people together. Follow for more little stories like this.
scenes.visual_description: At a warm cottage doorway, Mira and a kind older woman watch the silver moth glow between them; a tiny workshop window shines behind the house.
scenes.setting: warm cottage doorway on a rainy night
scenes.action: sharing a relieved smile beside the lantern
